rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a body organ in general, especially in health or biology contexts.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hei3 gun1 hou2 zung6 jiu3

rows.note: Use this for internal organs or viscera, rather than as the general biological term.

example.english: The doctor said my internal organ was fine.
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 go3 noi6 zong6 mou5 si6

rows.note: Use this for the musical instrument sense when the context makes clear that an organ is meant.

example.english: The organ in the church sounds very powerful.
example.traditional: 教堂入面嗰部風琴好有氣勢。
example.jyutping: gaau3 tong4 jap6 min6 go2 bou6 fung1 kam4 hou2 jau5 hei3 sai3

rows.note: This is a vulgar slang term for the penis.

example.english: He said his organ was sore.
example.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 tiu4 gau1 tung3
